options.name: --literal
options.description: Do not normalize latin script letters before matching

name: -n
--nth
options.description: Comma-separated list of field index expressions for limiting search scope

options.description: Transform the presentation of each line using field index expressions

options.name: --tac
options.description: Reverse the order of the input

options.description: Comma-separated list of sort criteria to apply when the scores are tied

options.name: --bind

options.description: Keep the right end of the line visible on overflow

options.description: Make word-wise movements respect path separators

options.description: Label characters for jump and jump-accept

options.description: Display fzf window below the cursor with the given height instead of using full…

options.description: Minimum height when --height is given in percent

options.description: Enable processing of ANSI color codes

options.description: Number of spaces for a tab character

name: -q
--query
options.description: Start the finder with the given query

--filter
